scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix frontend run build && mkdir -p dist && cp -R frontend/dist/. dist/
scripts.build:frontend: node init && npm --prefix frontend run build && mkdir -p dist && cp -R frontend/dist/. dist/
scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd backend && yarn dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd frontend && yarn dev
scripts.dev: node init && npx concurrently -n Backend,Frontend -c cyan,magenta "yarn dev:backend" "yarn dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: yarn --cwd backend install && yarn --cwd frontend install
